title: Variable Bandwidth FIR Filter
text: Design tunable bandwidth FIR filter, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Filter type} sets Filter type; {FIR filter order}, {Specify cutoff frequency from input port}, {Filter cutoff frequency}, {Specify center frequency from input port}, {Filter center frequency}, {Specify bandwidth from input port}, {Filter bandwidth}, {Window function}, {Chebyshev window sidelobe attenuation (dB)}, {Kaiser window parameter}, {Sample rate mode} sets the mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized, {Input sample rate (Hz)}, {View Filter Response} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Filter type
params.values: Filter type Lowpass (default) | Highpass | Bandpass | Bandstop

params.name: Specify cutoff frequency from input port
params.values: Specify cutoff frequency from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Specify center frequency from input port
params.values: Specify center frequency from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Specify bandwidth from input port
params.values: Specify bandwidth from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Window function
params.values: Window function Hann (default) | Hamming | Chebyshev | Kaiser

params.name: Chebyshev window sidelobe attenuation (dB)
params.values: Chebyshev window sidelobe attenuation 60 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample rate mode
params.values: Mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized frequency (0 to 1) (default) | Specify on dialog | Inherit from input port

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
